args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused 2.665 to round to
2.67 instead of 2.66, failing tests/test_money.py in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` documented banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but the implementation actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- Switched the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
